A '''furry humanoid creature''' lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Neg's monster|One example]] of these beings was kept as a caged pet by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Neg]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Game" />
